checks.name: V01a CANCEL with an upcoming visit: opt-out recorded, visit kept, one owner note linked to the visit, confirmation byte-identical to the standard STOP one; repeat is silent and adds nothing
V01b CANCEL without a visit keeps the standard confirmation and creates no owner note
V01c Twilio-handled CANCEL (OptOutType=STOP) stays silent but still tells the owner
V01d Spanish visit: CANCEL gets the same standard confirmation; the owner note is saved in Spanish context
V01e STOP (not CANCEL) with a visit is unchanged: standard confirmation, no owner visit note
V01f (QA Q20) paused workspace: CANCEL with a visit booked while live records the opt-out AND saves the owner note; its owner email waits until the workspace is live again
V01g (QA Q19) CANCEL with two upcoming visits: one owner note per visit, one standard confirmation
V02a default policy: SMS reschedule is direct: same visit moved (no duplicate), capacity re-checked, old slot released, owner told, old reminders superseded
V02b default policy: SMS cancel is a REQUEST: visit stays booked, slot held, one linked request for the owner, truthful reply, reminders held; the owner then cancels and reminders stop
V02c default policy: if the owner keeps the visit (completes the request), its reminders are released
V02d Spanish "cancelar" reaches the AI with the visit context; the confirmed cancel is saved as a request
V02e policy direct (owner opt-in): SMS cancel cancels the visit, releases capacity, tells the owner, queues the customer cancellation and stops reminders
V02f policy requests_only: an SMS reschedule is a request; the visit keeps its time and capacity
V02g request idempotency: replay of the same tool call reports the saved request even after the owner then cancels; a repeat under a new tool call adds no second request
V03a voice reschedule: without attestation A (none, B, A-Diverted) it is a request; with attestation A it is direct with idempotent replay
V03b voice cancel: a request by default even with attestation A; direct only under policy direct
V03c source: attestation comes only from the Twilio-signed inbound call (StirVerstat), is stored on the call record and is passed to the assistant context and the tool dispatch
V04 another verified number cannot see or change the visit by text or call

V07 (QA Q09) a visit whose number was typed (website) or given for someone else on a call is never listed or changeable by that number; a CANCEL from it still notes the owner and flags the number as unverified
V05 a full target window leaves the visit unchanged and books nothing new
V06 website chat cannot see or change visits; a change request is saved for the owner and the visit is untouched
V08 one workspace rule: rules.visitChanges accepts confirm_cancels|requests_only|direct (default confirm_cancels), rejects others, and leaves other workspaces' edit revision untouched
Q01 two concurrent customer changes to the same visit: one wins, no duplicate, capacity consistent
Q02 customer reschedule racing an owner cancel: exactly one outcome and truthful messages
Q03 change after the owner edited the visit applies to the current visit (recorded behaviour)
Q04 artificial past date: past visit not listed and not cancelled
Q05 artificial past date: reschedule to the future is also refused
Q06 completed visits cannot be changed or requested
Q07 cross-tenant: same phone, visit in shop A cannot be seen, changed or requested via shop B
Q08 spoofed SMS webhook (bad signature) and forged From (REST mismatch) are rejected before any visit logic
Q09 (inverted by N4) typed number on web: the holder of that number by SMS does not see the visit
Q10 opted-out customer who then cancels by phone: no SMS is sent to the suppressed number
Q11 blocked target window: truthful unchanged message
Q12 invalid window / elapsed window: unchanged and truthful
Q13 second cancel under a new tool-call ID after a cancel: says not found; owner not double-notified
Q14 workspace paused from the start: CANCEL still records the opt-out (recorded behaviour)
Q15 a held lock: "still being confirmed", no claim of success
Q04r realistic past visit (clock past its date, never marked done): no cancel, and no cancel request
Q05r realistic past visit: customer cannot move it to the future
Q16 replay of the SAME cancel tool call (provider retry) reports the cancel, not "no visit"
Q17 visit already on the way: neither applied nor silently requested; handed to the owner
Q18 replay of a customer move after the owner moved it again reports the current time, not the stale success
Q21 CANCELAR (exact word): an opt-out (with proposal 01) or an AI turn (without 01); never cancels the visit by itself and never adds a visit sentence
P01c control: no request -> the 24h and 1h reminders are sent before arrival
P01 cancel REQUEST, owner never acts: before arrival the customer must get some truthful message that the visit is still booked (reminder or status)
P02 move REQUEST (requests_only), owner never acts: customer must get a truthful still-booked message before the old time
P03 a NEW cancel request after the owner kept the visit (completed the first request) must reach the owner and hold reminders again
P04 returning-caller context must not use a WEBSITE-typed record: no first name, not "returning"
P05 returning-caller context must not use a WEBSITE notify_owner lead with a typed number
P06 CANCEL on a web-typed visit: the owner note must not launder the typed name into the texter's returning context
P07 RESIDUAL N6 pinned, reassigned number: a new holder of a number that booked by phone sees the visit and can MOVE it directly by text under the default rule
P08 RESIDUAL pinned, shared/family number: every verified visit on the number is listed; firstName is the latest record's
P09 RESIDUAL N7 pinned, owner-entered visit with a mistyped number counts as verified
P10 paused CANCEL note: its owner email is actually sent once the workspace is live again
P11 RESIDUAL N8 pinned, distinct move requests each create an owner request and email (no per-visit cap)
P12 RESIDUAL N5 pinned, a pending request is not marked in the next conversation's visit context
P13 hold is bound to the visit state: after the owner MOVES the visit (request open), the new time's reminders are sent
P14 while the request is open and arrival is more than 12 h away, the due 24h reminder is held (not sent)
P15 owner closes the request without the follow-through journal (lead not open): the hold releases and the due reminder is sent; the same ask again is a new open request that holds again
P16 CANCEL owner note: a name typed with an unverified number stays in the note text and is never saved as the texter's name; a verified visit keeps its name
P17 a later booking from the number does not close its open visit-change request or CANCEL note (desk.bookVisit closes only plain leads); the hold stays
P18 returning context and hold edges: a number given for someone else on a call is not trusted for that number; a hold needs its visit; the request-mode prompt warns of the reminder
Q3-D2 repro: a managed booking of a second visit closes the open cancel request on the first visit, releases its hold, and the 24h reminder for the visit the customer asked to cancel is sent
Q3-D3 repro: a non-stable website notify_owner with the same number inside 30 minutes merges into the open request and overwrites its name, issue and reason
Q3-D1 impact (latent on rev2+fix): with a website-typed visit and a verified visit on one number, CANCEL leaves desk.callerContext and customerContext naming the verified caller
Q3-L1 legit: a customer with an open cancel request who really books a second visit gets it saved, the second visit is not held and its reminder is sent; a plain lead from the number is still closed

Q3-L2 legit: a family member typing the same number on the website gets a separate lead; a second website message from them still merges into their own older lead (not skipped because a newer request exists); a CANCEL note is never a merge target
Q3-L3 legit: owner completes the request in the portal (real follow-through API): hold releases; a later booking leaves it alone; reopen holds again; asking again after completion is a new request
Q3-L4 legit closure: an ordinary SMS lead (no relatedVisitId) from the number is still closed by the booking; owner cancelling the visit ends the hold (request lead itself stays open: residual)
Q3-L5 legit/family: a website booking by someone else typing the same number closes only that number's plain web lead, not the open request or CANCEL note on the verified visit
